name: Stacktrace
long_description:
Agents will do most of the work in the future, but only if teams can trust them unsupervised.
Stacktrace is the control layer for every agent: it sees every action, detects risky behavior, enforces the bounds your team sets, and steps in when an agent drifts from intent.
one_liner: See and control what your agents actually do

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Vinod Kone, Founder and CEO of Stacktrace (YC F26). Previously VP of Engineering at Harness, where he led platform engineering and owned software supply-chain security, and Senior Director at Twilio Segment. Former Apache Mesos PMC Chair; scaled Mesos to 30,000 nodes at Twitter. PhD in CS from UC Santa Barbara.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder of Stacktrace (YC F26). Previously Head of Infrastructure, Security and AI Platforms at Airtable. Before that, he led developer platform and cloud infrastructure orgs at Databricks, Pinterest and Twitter. He holds an MS in Computer Science from SUNY.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Stacktrace (YC F26). Previously Engineering Leader at Amazon (2011-2026), where he built GenAI systems at Amazon Ads and foundational services across AWS and Alexa. MS in CS from Texas A&M, B.Tech from IIT Guwahati.
